tasks.description: Crear variante 'primary' del componente Button (extendiendo shadcn/ui): fondo #00ff9d, texto on-primary-container oscuro bold, sin borde. Estilos via cva (class-variance-authority) con Tailwind
Crear variante 'secondary/ghost' del componente Button: fondo transparente, borde 1px esmeralda, texto esmeralda. Hover: fondo esmeralda al 10% opacity
Crear variante 'icon' del componente Button: circular (rounded-full), transparente, hover tint esmeralda 15%. Soporte para tamanos sm/default/lg/icon

Implementar estados interactivos en todas las variantes: hover (glow esmeralda en primary, tint en secondary/icon), focus-visible (outline 2px + glow), active (scale 0.98), disabled (opacity 40%, cursor-not-allowed, aria-disabled). Transicion 200ms ease
Crear tests unitarios (Vitest + Testing Library) para variante primary: renderizado, hover glow, focus outline, active scale, disabled no interactivo
Crear tests unitarios para variantes secondary, ghost e icon: renderizado, hover, focus, disabled. Verificar tamanos sm/default/lg/icon
Crear tests de accesibilidad: focus-visible con teclado (Tab), aria-disabled en estado disabled, role='button', compatibilidad con asChild de Radix

Crear archivo .feature con los 10 escenarios Gherkin de US-003 (Should_RenderPrimaryButton, Should_ShowHoverState, Should_ShowFocusState, Should_ShowActiveState, Should_RenderDisabledState, Should_RenderSecondaryButton, Should_ShowHoverState_When_SecondaryButtonIsHovered, Should_RenderIconButton, Should_ShowHoverState_When_IconButtonIsHovered, Should_SupportAllButtonSizes)
Implementar step definitions para botones: renderizado de cada variante, interacciones hover/focus/active/disabled, verificacion de estilos computados via Playwright
